_comment: AUTHOR GUIDANCE (not enforced). Per-unit scope projected from the Syntax Coverage Appendix in 01-unit-roadmap.md. A sub-agent authoring a unit reads its 'allows' (the cumulative toolbox it MAY use) and 'excludes' (everything not yet introduced, which it MUST NOT use). Scope is a rule authors follow; the validator does not enforce it (prose and code share too many tokens to match reliably). Regenerate: python3 gen_scope.py
